bundle.shortDescription: A focus timer where every session is a flight.
bundle.longDescription: Contrail turns focus time into flights. Pick how long you want to work, and the departures board shows real cities about that far away. Board, and a live map flies you there while you work, with cabin sound and the captain's announcements. Land and the city goes into your logbook. Free and open source, on Windows, macOS and Linux, with nothing sent anywhere.
